title: Plural affirmative yes/no questions
focus: Form olemmeko, oletteko, and ovatko questions for plural persons.

exercises.instruction: Choose the best question form.
exercises.prompt: Complete “Are we still here?” ____ me täällä vielä?
exercises.explanation: Olemme takes the question suffix -ko to form olemmeko.

optionFeedback.olemmeko: Correct. Olemme takes the question suffix -ko to form olemmeko.
optionFeedback.oletteko: “oletteko” does not fit this subject or construction. Olemme takes the question suffix -ko to form olemmeko.
optionFeedback.ovatko: “ovatko” does not fit this subject or construction. Olemme takes the question suffix -ko to form olemmeko.
